reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.bounded_interface_domain: A specified detector/abnormal condition and a named technical evidence method, content, scope or contextual claim in one of the ten explicit receiving records. The detector definition, result or coverage limitation must concern that exact decision object; arbitrary encoded data and co-use are excluded.
source_record.domain_horizon_authority: The identified requirement, integration, intended use, envelope, trace query, hazard, argument, anomaly, transition or recurring evidence decision and its relevant version/change interval. Receipt, acknowledgment, response, technical truth and empowered disposition remain separate.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Analytical directional inference from complete native meanings and honestly reused primary scopes. No causal field benefit, observed detector reliability, universal instrument/board/test layer, historical transmission or complete assurance follows.

source_refs.role: Inherited selected practitioner guidance separates monitoring, alerting, investigation and mitigation; no detector-performance theorem.

source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Use the existing sufficient detector, manual report, focused query or evidence path where adequate. Count collection/validation, instrumentation upkeep, false-alarm attention, responder capacity, delay, access/privacy and duplicate bookkeeping. Shared data does not create independent benefits, and a useful pair does not establish a feasible whole package.

source_record.independent_review_scope: The two later sequential reviewers must challenge the common inference and each of ten exact native member bridges, including authority exceptions, evidence-confidence limits and independent reverse judgments. This author validation is not review acceptance.
source_record.common_source_dependence: A shared detector, pipeline, report or inherited source can fail together. Ten receiving interfaces are not ten independent observations, controls or benefits.
source_record.native_common_basis: EL-011 defines a specified abnormal condition, detection/communication scope, uncertainty and accountable signal path. Each named receiver has an explicit native evidence-method, content, scope or contextual-evaluation need. The per-member bridge below identifies that need without assuming a whole receiving predicate or a response is established.

common_subconditions.P1: The detector/condition and the exact receiving object, version and technical question are identified.
common_subconditions.P2: A complete native receiver field establishes the specific evidence-method/content/scope need, and the source supplies the stated detector definition, result or limitation.
common_subconditions.P3: That information has the declared bounded consequence for the receiving analysis at its confidence; it is not automatic truth, universal invalidation or compelled action.
common_subconditions.P4: Remaining premises, outside-domain counterexample, adequate alternative, cost and re-entry are explicit. Authority exceptions and all reverses receive separate judgments.

source_record.inference: When P1–P4 hold, include the stated detection information or coverage limitation in the receiving technical analysis. It can support, qualify or expose a missing premise while the broader claim stays unresolved or the selected action remains unchanged. A mere alert bit, name or stored artifact does not satisfy these conditions.

member_to_premise_evidence.guard: A detector or signal-path test concerns the deployed configuration, people, procedures or support required for the contemplated cutover or restart.
member_to_premise_evidence.member_to_common_premise: The native receiver distinguishes product tests from evidence about the actual enabling system; missing real response is a readiness premise, not merely a missing slide.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: An observed condition or failed transmission/acknowledgment link in the relevant rehearsal or operative environment.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: Readiness evidence gains a specific failure/gap or supported limited capability; the detector test is not a complete cutover authorization or recovery demonstration.
premises_supplied: An observed condition or failed transmission/acknowledgment link in the relevant rehearsal or operative environment.
premises_remaining: Other enabling resources, real contingency capability and the appropriate transition authority remain open.
The source signal retains its actual confidence and validity; a declared source property or qualified native label is not an observed result.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: A development dashboard is green while the deployed night-shift responder cannot receive the alert.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: No actual stated common object/condition or receiving evidence need; co-use is insufficient. A discriminating confirmation may remain material without changing the chosen action.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: A development dashboard is green while the deployed night-shift responder cannot receive the alert.
member_to_premise_evidence.specific_cost_and_limit: Familiar reversible deployment may use existing automated checks and on-call confirmation rather than a meeting; test only consequential changed premises.

member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen when the named condition, scope, object/version, source confidence, receiving criterion, actual authority, control failure or cheaper adequate path changes. A defect in a common premise requires review of every exact rule member and downstream composition; do not extend to other Lean properties or infer a reverse by similarity.

EL-011.bearer: A detector and signal path for a specified abnormal condition
EL-011.proposition: Detect and signal specified decision-relevant abnormalities, separating detection, transmission, acknowledgement and response.
EL-011.criterion: Separate detection, transmission, acknowledgement and response; demonstrate each required link at its scope.

EW-P031.bearer: A pipeline producing or consuming recurring assurance evidence
EW-P031.proposition: Continuous, configuration-linked evidence with explicit coverage limits, risk gates, monitoring and human/independent authority at consequential boundaries.
EW-P031.criterion: Its outputs are configuration-linked, interpretable, trustworthy and consumed by appropriate technical and operational decisions.

member_to_premise_evidence.shared_question_or_object: A recurring pipeline or monitoring output used as assurance evidence
member_to_premise_evidence.guard: The specified detector/result is generated or consumed by the relevant integration/assurance pipeline and its meaning or coverage affects reliance on that output.
member_to_premise_evidence.member_to_common_premise: The native receiver requires configuration-linked, interpretable and trustworthy recurring outputs consumed by appropriate decisions.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: A meaningful abnormality definition, detector-quality limitation or current scoped result rather than an unexplained green/red count.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: Pipeline evidence can be interpreted at its actual coverage and confidence, with known gaps retained; continuous generation does not create complete or independent assurance.
premises_supplied: A meaningful abnormality definition, detector-quality limitation or current scoped result rather than an unexplained green/red count.
premises_remaining: Pipeline integrity, test validity, unautomated claims and technical/operational authority remain separate.
The source signal retains its actual confidence and validity; a declared source property or qualified native label is not an observed result.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: A compromised or constant-green check is reproduced perfectly on every run and never tests the claimed failure.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: No actual stated common object/condition or receiving evidence need; co-use is insufficient. A discriminating confirmation may remain material without changing the chosen action.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: A compromised or constant-green check is reproduced perfectly on every run and never tests the claimed failure.
member_to_premise_evidence.specific_cost_and_limit: Manual evidence may suffice at low cadence; automate only useful recurring checks and preserve adequate current evidence without forcing a platform.
